title: Meta's Muse can now control your Spotify
description: Meta's Muse AI agent has received support for Spotify today, following a bunch of other connections with existing services that were recently announced (Box, GitHub, Granola, Notion, Expedia, Turo, Viator, 1Password, OpenTable, Peloton, Plaid, Ticketmaster, as well as a bunch of others including Shopify's Shop Pay, Stripe's Link, and PayPal for payments). Now, Muse can connect to Spotify too (just ask it to), and it can play music, audiobooks, and podcasts, save stuff to your library, build playlists, and also help you find new music, books, or podcasts, all from within your conversation...

title: Apple will keep paying Qualcomm royalties for its patents
description: Today in an incredibly short one-paragraph press release, Qualcomm has announced that it has renewed its global patent licensing agreement with Apple. The renewal goes into effect from April 1, 2027. Attached is probably the world's shortest quote inside a press release: "We are pleased to extend the Apple license agreement", Qualcomm Executive Vice President and General Manager of Qualcomm Technology Licensing, John Han, said. Undoubtedly, this is all so concise and mysterious because the actual terms of the agreement are confidential. This new patent licensing agreement comes after the...

title: Disney+ and Hulu subscriptions are getting expensive
description: Disney is raising prices for monthly Disney+ and Hulu subscriptions for new and existing users. The ad-free Disney+ and Hulu plans will cost $2.50 more, so you'll now pay $21.49 for each. The ad-free Disney+ and Hulu bundle will cost $21.99, which is a $2 increase. The ad-supported Disney+ and Hulu plans will cost $0.50 more, so you'll now pay $12.49 each, while the ad-supported Disney+ and Hulu bundle remains unchanged at $12.99. Existing users should have already received the price-hike notification, and the new prices will take effect for them in the next billing...

title: GrapheneOS confirms the first Motorola to support the privacy-focused Android fork
description: This March, GrapheneOS announced a partnership with Motorola. This Android fork has an uncompromising focus on security and privacy to the point where it only supports a limited number of phones – if a phone is missing a hardware feature that is vital for security, it doesn’t get a GrapheneOS port. Naturally, the expectation that the new Motorola Signature 27 will become the first Moto to support this fork was met with the cloud of doubt. Well, doubt no more – the official GrapheneOS account on X confirmed that the new Signature will become the first Motorola phone to be...

title: Verizon finally launches the Motorola Razr Fold, Razr+ 2026, and Razr 2026 with Swarovski crystals
description: Today, Verizon has announced the nationwide availability of three Motorola devices: the Razr Fold, Razr+ 2026, and Razr 2026 with Swarovski crystals. The Razr Fold is priced at $1,949.99, but you can have it for $25 per month with a four-year device payment plan, if you pick Verizon's Simplicity plan. That means you only spend $1,200 in total for the device. The Razr 2026 with Crystals by Swarovski is priced at $999.99, but you can have it for $10 per month for four years (a total of just $480). The Razr+ 2026 is priced at $1,099.99, but you can have it for $15 per month for four...

title: OnePlus 16 complete camera hardware detailed
description: OnePlus has revealed the full camera specs of its upcoming flagship, the OnePlus 16. The handset is confirmed to launch in China soon and will be powered by Qualcomm’s newly announced Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. The OnePlus 16 will feature a triple rear camera setup headlined by a 200MP primary sensor with a 1/1.4 inch size and an f/1.6 aperture. It will also offer a 50MP periscope telephoto camera with 3x optical zoom and a 50MP ultrawide camera with a 116 degree field of view. For selfies, the handset will feature a 50MP front facing camera. The OnePlus 16 will...

title: The new Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 is a chip for camera-equipped headphones
description: Despite its name, the new Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 is designed not just for headphones, but for hybrid devices too – camera-enabled earbuds, audio glasses and future form factors. This chip doubles the on-board AI compute compared to the Gen 1 (it’s now rated at 0.128 TOPS), while also reducing power consumption by 40%. It also has a 30% smaller footprint on the motherboard. “With Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2, we’re heralding intelligent audio wearables that enable experiences such as real-time translation, contextual assistance, personalized hearing, and multimodal interactions...

title: Microsoft unveils Surface Pro 12" tablet and Surface Laptop 13" with Snapdragon X2 Plus
description: While smartphone makers flocked to the Snapdragon Summit to reveal phones with the new flagship chipsets, Microsoft picked a chip from earlier this year, the Snapdragon X2 Plus, to power two new Surface devices. Starting with the Microsoft Surface Pro 12” (2nd edition), this is a highly portable 12” Windows on ARM tablet with a 2,196 x 1,464px (3:2) PixelSense LCD and 90Hz refresh rate. Besides regular touch input, it also supports the optional Surface Slim Pen (which can detect 4,096 levels of pressure). The Surface Pro 12” supports touch and stylus input Microsoft also introduced...

title: Honor X9e Pro arrives with 11,000mAh battery and Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chip
description: The brand-new Honor X9e Pro is now official in Malaysia, and it brings two standout features. The first is a 10,000-nit bright display, which we’ll cover in a bit, and the second is an 11,000mAh battery. That’s the same typical capacity as the Honor X80 Pro Max, which launched earlier in June, and both phones share the similar core specs. The impressive battery capacity is achieved thanks to silicon-carbon anode tech, and Honor’s lab tests claim the X9e Pro can do over 164 hours of music streaming, 35 hours of short-form video playback and well over 66 hours of regular video playback....

description: Apple has confirmed that it's working on a fix for a pretty bad bug that has been affecting some iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max units. If everything goes according to plan, the fix will be incorporated into a new firmware update that is scheduled to be released next week. description: Yesterday, Xiaomi unveiled the 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max in China. Less than 24 hours later, the company has already officially confirmed that the "Xiaomi 18 Pro series" (so, both phones) will be getting global launches at some point in the future. title: Meta Muse Charm is a standalone AI device coming later this year
description: Right after unveiling the new camera-less Ray-Ban Meta Audio and Meta VR glasses, Mark Zuckerberg went to a “one-more thing” device – the Meta Muse Charm. As the name implies, this is a standalone keychain-like/Tamagotchi type device that allows users to interact with Meta’s Muse AI. Meta Muse Charm From the sound of it, the device is in its late development phase, but Zuckerberg did confirm that it should ship in time for the holidays in December. Muse Charm supports voice input and features interchangeable avatars. It also gets a front-facing camera, a fingerprint sensor on...

title: vivo S2 FE specs and images leak, 10,000 mAh battery takes the spotlight
description: Back in August, vivo resurrected the S line in India with the S2. And now, according to a new leak from a tipster on X, the company is working on the S2 FE. Its specs have purportedly been outed along with the two images you can see below. Before we go any further we need to caution you about the fact that this is not a tipster with a long track record of accurate leaks - so the usual pinch of salt may need to be bigger in this case. With that out of the way, let's dive in. vivo S2 FE leaked images The S2 FE's main claim to fame will undoubtedly be its 10,000 mAh battery, which...

title: Oppo starts blind Find X10 series pre-orders in the UK with tons of freebies
description: Oppo unveiled the Find X10, Find X10 E, and Find X10 Pro Max in China yesterday. While the devices are not yet official for global markets, Oppo has already started taking blind pre-orders for them in the UK. The company is basically offering you the opportunity to save either £150 on the Find X10 or £200 on the Find X10 Pro Max. On top of that, you'll also get your choice between a free Hasselblad teleconverter kit, a free Oppo Watch X3, or a free Oppo Pad 5. All you need to do is put down a £49 deposit and wait for the devices to launch in the UK. There's not even an officially...

title: vivo V80 hands-on and camera samples from Bangkok, Thailand
description: vivo will unveil the V80 in India on October 6 at 12 PM local time. It will come in three colors: Sunrise Anthem, Horizon Blue, and Stellar Black. We recently got our hands on the vivo V80's Sunrise Anthem model, and you can check the images below for a real-world look at it. The vivo V80 sports a 6.59" 1.5K OLED display on the front with 5,000 nits peak brightness and a 144Hz refresh rate. The screen brightness can drop to 1 nit, and it can also display 1.07 billion colors. There's also a centered punch-hole for a 50MP "ZEISS Group Selfie Camera." Around the back is a camera system...

title: Meta announces new VR Glasses and camera-free Ray-Ban Meta Audio
description: Meta has announced two new pairs of smart glasses at Meta Connect 2026. The company unveiled its first camera-free, audio-only Ray Ban Meta Audio, along with a new pair of virtual reality glasses simply called Meta VR Glasses. The Meta VR Glasses use a two-part system, with the glasses housing the display and sensors, while a connected puck handles the computing and houses the storage and battery. The glasses connect to the puck via an optical cable. Thanks to this two-part design, the glasses themselves weigh just 100 grams. They feature micro OLED displays with 5K resolution and...

title: Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro and Pad 9 announced
description: Alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, which were unveiled in China, the company also launched the Pad 9 Pro and Pad 9 tablets. The new models join the Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max, which debuted earlier this month. The Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro is the larger one with a 12.5-inch LCD display that offers a 144Hz refresh rate and a 3.2K resolution. The tablet is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, which is paired with up to 12GB of RAM and 256GB of UFS 4.1 storage. It gets a 50MP primary rear camera and a 32MP front camera. The Pad 9 Pro packs a 11,000mAh battery and supports 67W...

title: Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition unboxing and hands-on
description: After Realme partnered with Warner Bros on the Realme 15 Pro Game of Thrones Edition, it's time for the Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition! As blockbusters go, these two are not easy to beat. The phone on which this special edition is based is great on its own merit, but it's still the Harry Potter stuff that's more interesting. And there's a lot of that here. For starters, everything is packed inside the tiny little Hogwarts school trunk. title: Amazfit's T-Rex Dual Solar smartwatch offers dual-sided solar charging
description: Amazfit has unveiled the T-Rex Dual Solar, a new solar powered smartwatch featuring solar panels on both the front and rear. The dual solar panels can extend battery life when the watch is exposed to sunlight. The Amazfit T-Rex Dual Solar is claimed to offer up to 21 days of typical usage from its built-in 660mAh battery. However, when worn on the wrist and exposed to three hours of direct sunlight each day, the typical battery life can increase to 34 days. Meanwhile, exposing the larger solar panel on the rear to three hours of direct sunlight daily can extend the typical usage...

title: Realme 16 Pro 5G Harry Potter Edition and Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition sold out
description: A couple of days ago, Realme unveiled the 16 Pro 5G Harry Potter Edition and the Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition. People seem to have really liked them, as both products have sold out in the company's online store in India within 24 hours of the launch. If you want either one now, you'll have to go and check offline brick-and-mortar stores hoping you'll be lucky enough to find one which still has stock.
